content.rationale: The node-set module. It enumerates the node ids from jj — the candidate listing of the changes touching `nodes/`, each kept only where the change carries its own document `nodes/<its own change id>.json` (D1b), so a change that only touches the path is not a node (S2-set, ryzlzrkk) — through the runner (M-jj, zruxtxrv) rather than the working copy's directory; a candidate whose own document is absent is dropped as not-a-node, while every other load failure is read through the read interface (S2-read, nqktpzuu) and surfaced as a value rather than an abort; the caller — log's all-or-nothing read, validate's per-node report — decides what a failure means. It names ids through store_path (vkztyrzm) and loads through node_load (sxonuzmr); D3 (volxoyyy) fixes the edges to report and D4 (mqqwzvwz) that targets are sibling ids with the root excepted, while S2-path (pumpuqkv) fixes the one layout and S2-invalid (uzvzopwp) the failure shape. M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/node_set.rs, and I1-serde (orrvsxqq) fixes the JSON layer it is written against. The set no longer loads each document itself: it enumerates the candidate ids, hands them to M-store-bulk (xlvtxsky), and maps each returned document to Loaded, each absence to a skip, and each failure to Failed.
